first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender, dark-colored long gun held by Person A, with prominent light-colored mottling on the body and a protruding sighting component at the front.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The undulating gray-black muddy ground, mud ridges, low-lying passages, and scattered rubble in the lower part of the scene.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The nearby damaged window-like opening and the gray-black ruined brick-and-stone walls and low walls outside it.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: Leafless trunks, remnant branches, and broken tree stumps of varying heights and thicknesses, including the relatively nearby slanted, pointed stump on the right in the later part.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The smoke-cloud-filled sky behind the scenery, grayish white at the beginning, with a large area in the direction faced in the later part appearing yellow-green.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The orange-yellow flames and tiny warm-colored glowing points near the ruins and ground.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Person A, who holds Weapon A from a first-person perspective; only parts of the dark-colored gloves and the dark-colored legs and feet while stepping over are visible, while the face and full body are out of frame.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: A locally dense gray-black smoke cloud with diffuse edges near the ruins.
